Herod devoured of Worms

Richard Crashaw (G.) (c. 1613–1649)

A
CTS
 
XII.
 23
.
B
EHOLD
 a god! full voic’d the people cry;
Not man, but god, with shouts they him attest,
What kind of god he is, ye worms, reply—
A crowd that know the secrets of his breast.
